values.name: /settings/driver_quest1/ignoreSystemWhileMoving
values.label: Ignore Oculus and Menu buttons while moving
values.text: A press of the Oculus or Menu button that begins while the controller swings or moves fast is ignored: on Touch controllers they are easy to press by mistake.

values.name: /settings/driver_quest1/chargeSound
values.label: Play a sound when the charger is plugged in
values.text: Meta's original charging sound, played from the headset's own system partition (on by default).

values.name: /settings/driver_quest1/clearSpatialAnchors
values.label: Spatial anchor map
values.text: Forgets the room map the headset finds its place in after a restart or a tracking loss. A new map is saved as soon as a playspace is set up again (or after about a minute worn).
